newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain quietly in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain quietly in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained quietly this afternoon with only three nearby trades reported, market sources said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $280 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Sept at $277 a tonne cif. Dutch high protein soymeal pellets changed hands at $310 a tonne fob for this week delivery.
"There was little faith in the market and only a few nearby trades occured on the back of calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening coupled to a weaker dollar," one broker said.
